recipes.name: Easy Chicken Pasta
ingredients_raw: 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cut into cubes

steps.text: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the linguine, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink.

Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper. Add the chicken and garlic to the skillet. Cook and stir until the chicken is no longer pink in the center, 7 to 10 minutes. Stir in the white wine. Toss the pasta with chicken in the skillet until the chicken is evenly distributed.

raw_recipe.headline: Easy Chicken Pasta
raw_recipe.description: Dinner's on the table in a jiffy with this garlicky chicken and pasta meal.

review.reviewBody: I agree with the other reviews...needs more zip. What I did was to pound some Montreal Seasoning into the chicken before cutting it into strips rather than chunks. Sauteed in evoo and butter before adding the garlic just so the garlic wouldn't burn and get bitter. Added some broccoli that I had on hand and threw in a few pieces of tomato that I also had. The additions made it a bit more interesting and more flavorful. Enjoy.

I agree with others. I feel this is a great base but added additional ingredients. I sauteed 8 oz of fresh sliced mushrooms in a bit of butter and removed them when cooked. I then added the chicken and seasoned with TJ's Everday Seasoning (garlic, pepper, paprika, salt) and cooked until done. I added a small package of steamed cooked broccoli and sun dried tomatoes packed in oil that I sliced. When I added the pasta, I topped with the oil left in the jar from the tomatoes which also added some extra flavor.
I seasoned the chicken really good and added some brocolli. After adding the pasta to the pan, I stired in a 1/2 of Clearman's Original Spread. That made it amazing!

I made this but I also agree that it needed a little kick to it. So before I cooked it I marinated my chicken in a sauce i made with some olive oil, balsamic vinegar, red wine, oregano, and rosemary. Then I cooked it in the olive oil with a little garlic and the white wine. It was delicious!

This was easy and fast. Other reviews indicated this recipe needed some extra flavor, so I was liberal with the salt and pepper called for and also added poultry seasoning to the chicken. I served this with a side of steamed broccoli. After tasting, we added shredded sharp white cheddar cheese and it was a delicious addition that I really liked.
Great easy pasta dish that the kids love. I tend to add a little more garlic since I love garlic. I usually let the cooking wine mostly cook off so it's mostly olive oil to coat the chicken.

Very fast and easy. Worked perfectly for a weeknight on the first day of the semester. Added yellow onion, dry ground oregano, dry ground cilantro, dry ground lemon peel, and a tablespoon of unsalted butter.
i've done this often when pressed for time. it's ok, but needs added spices. black and red pepper, some basil or whatever you have on hand. as written, it's a bit bland.
It was very bland. I will probably make again and doctor it up.
I added a tomato, sliced olive,fresh cilantro, celery, italian seasoning,red pepper and feta cheese. Pretty much everything in the fridge. Great base recipe.......

Super Helpful! Like most people, I didn't follow directions step for step, but this is a great instructional on how to get to where you want to go. Everyone's tastes are a little different, but if you haven't made a chicken pasta before, this will get you going...made my day! Thank you!
Yummy, and quick!! I'm a new mom, and need recipes that I can make in between baby crys!! This one, and to the list, mommy!

I needed a quick and easy recipe and had very little on hand. How amazing that everything here (ok garlic powder instead of cloves) on hand! This worked out perfect for us. I served it with a broccoli and Parmesan cheese. Easy fix, even easier clean up! Thank you for posting, this is going in my recipe box. :D
This was super easy and quick to make, but like the other reviewer said, as written it is a bit bland. If I make it again, I will flavor it up a bit with spices and herbs that my family enjoys.
